entities.summary: Manuel Latusa is an Austrian professional ice hockey winger who is currently playing with EC Red Bull Salzburg of the Austrian Hockey League (EBEL). He first participated as a member of the Austrian National Team at the 2010 IIHF World Championship and has been a mainstay of the team since.
